schema:
CREATE TABLE Pilots (pilot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, callsign TEXT NOT NULL, is_certified INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Incidents (incident_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pilot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, report_date TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (pilot_id) REFERENCES Pilots (pilot_id));
correct_query: SELECT p.pilot_id, p.callsign FROM Pilots AS p WHERE p.is_certified = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Incidents AS i WHERE i.pilot_id = p.pilot_id AND i.outcome = 'GROUNDED')

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Adds a spurious temporal lower bound i.report_date >= '2021-01-01' inside the NOT EXISTS subquery, failing to exclude pilots whose grounding incident occurred before '2021-01-01'.
